title: Growatt Shine PV Power Leaderboard
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=growatt:inverter pv_power_w=*
| stats sum(pv_power_w) as total_value, avg(pv_power_w) as avg_value by plant_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks plant values by total and average pv power across Growatt inverter reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `pv_power_w` values for each Growatt inverter reading event and review total and average pv power by plant.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total pv power.
grandmaExplanation: It charts which plant shows the biggest pv power numbers in your Growatt inverter reading data.
